map.DASH 饮食评分 = 全谷物 + 蔬菜 + 水果 + 低脂乳制品 + 钠摄入: The DASH diet score = whole grains + vegetables + fruit + low-fat dairy + sodium intake + nuts and beans + red meat + sweets and sugary drinks (8 items scored 1 to 5 each, 40 points total). Adherence = total score ÷ 40 × 100%. At least 80% means high adherence, 60% to 79% means moderate, and below 60% means low. The key to qualifying is plenty of vegetables and fruit plus limited sodium.

map.DASH 关注：钠 <2300mg(理想<1500mg)、钾 4700mg、全谷: DASH focuses on sodium below 2300 mg (ideally below 1500 mg), potassium at 4700 mg, whole grains, 8 to 10 servings of vegetables and fruit, 2 to 3 servings of low-fat milk, nuts and beans, less red meat and sweets, and less saturated fat. The more of the 8 items you meet, the higher the score.
map.把午餐肉/酱菜换蒸蔬+香蕉(钾高)，钠从 2300 降到 1500 内、钾升到: Replace lunch meats and pickles with steamed vegetables plus a banana, which is high in potassium. Sodium drops from 2300 to within 1500 while potassium rises above 4000, improving both the score and blood pressure support.
map.DASH 和减盐什么关系？: What Is the Relationship Between DASH and Salt Reduction?
map.减盐是核心，但 DASH 更强调整体：高钾高镁高钙+全谷蔬果+低脂乳，协同降压优: Salt reduction is the core, but DASH also adjusts the whole pattern: high potassium, magnesium and calcium plus whole grains, vegetables, fruit and low-fat dairy work together to lower blood pressure better than simply eating less salt.
map.评分高能不吃药吗？: Can a High Score Replace Medication?
map.不能替代药物；DASH 是生活方式辅助，已服降压药者仍需遵医嘱、以饮食配合。: No. DASH is a lifestyle aid and cannot replace medication. Anyone already taking antihypertensive drugs should still follow medical advice and use the diet as support.
